summary.zh: 通过索引与执行计划分析优化慢查询
summary.en: Speed up slow queries with indexes and EXPLAIN

description.zh: 结合 EXPLAIN 分析、索引策略和查询改写定位数据库性能瓶颈。适合排查慢查询、设计表结构或上线前做性能评估。实际效果取决于数据库版本与数据分布。
description.en: Diagnose slow queries with EXPLAIN plans, indexing strategies, and query rewrites. Useful for performance debugging, schema design, and pre-launch reviews; results vary with database version and data volume.
